Q: Is web development still a good career option with the rise of AI tools? A:

You're asking about solutions looking for problems. Better to think about problems "out there" that you can "train yourself" to solve. For all their "knowledge", chat bots can only spew "text". We need better ways to "visualize" and manipulate information. "Hypermedia".

Q: How to compile just one file in C#? A:

Since .net-10 you can build and publish single file projects, i.e. project consisting from a single .cs file - see the File-based apps.

For example on a Linux machine:

  1. Create a single .cs file (SingleFile.cs in my case):

    Console.WriteLine("hello from single file");

  2. Use the dotnet publish command (note 1. by default a Native AOT is used in this case so you need to install the prerequisites 2. you will need another RID for Mac OS):

    dotnet publish SingleFile.cs -r linux-x64

  3. Run it from the artifacts folder:

If you don't want a Native AOT version then you can either define needed variables in the file itself or pass them to the build command. For example I used the following:

#:property PublishAot=false

Console.WriteLine("hello from single file");

dotnet publish SingleFile.cs -r linux-x64 -p:PublishSingleFile=true

Which also resulted in the single file self-contained application.

You can also use packages in file-based apps via #:package directive.

  • .NET RID Catalog
  • Native AOT deployment
